params.name: blob
params.description: BLOB from which to get the Real value

params.name: realFormat
params.description: Internal format and byte ordering of the Real value to read

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset within the BLOB (expressed in bytes); on return, incremented by the number of bytes read (8 or 10) so it can be reused for the next read

overloads.semanticRole: Reads and returns a Real value from a BLOB at a given (or default) byte offset, honoring an explicit internal format/byte ordering, and advances the offset variable by the bytes consumed (8 or 10).

constraints: offset must be between 0 and (BLOB size - 8 or - 10, depending on realFormat); otherwise error -111 is generated.
